first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, making a tightly targeted pricing test the highest-priority response for qualified-revenue protection and acquisition. Memory 73 is directly relevant but requires verification because its result pooled cohorts after a mid-test redefinition. Memory 86 is verified in parallel because declining onboarding completion may constrain conversion and long-term value from any acquired accounts. A guarded test limits discounting, margin, and low-quality-customer risk.
